name: claude-pets
description: A pixel cat that hangs out on your Claude window, plus mini games (2048) to play while Claude works.
long_description: Claude Pets adds a pixel cat that walks, sleeps and plays fetch on top of Claude's input bar. Double-click the cat for the console: pet controls and games. Ask Claude to "open game" to play 2048 in the side browser pane. macOS only.

tools.name: open_game
tools.description: Open a mini game (2048) in the browser pane
